description: This file contains Python functions for processing and visualizing repaint invalidation data, including extracting layer trees from text and generating an HTML overlay for visual comparison of repaint regions.

methods.name: result_contains_repaint_rects
methods.description: Checks if the input text contains repaint invalidation rectangles.

methods.name: extract_layer_tree
methods.description: Extracts a layer tree JSON-like structure from input string.

methods.name: generate_repaint_overlay_html
methods.description: Generates an HTML page to overlay expected and actual repaint regions for visual comparison.
